1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: // Controls: ←/→ rotate, ↑ thrust, space for manual fuel boost (optional).
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
13:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
14: 
15:   // --- Game constants ---
16:   const SHIP_SIZE = 15; // radius for drawing
17:   const SHIP_THRUST = 0.1;
18:   const SHIP_TURN_SPEED = 0.06; // radians per frame
19:   const FUEL_DEPLETION = 0.02; // per frame
20:   const FUEL_PICKUP_AMOUNT = 30;
21:   const ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED = 0.5;
22:   const ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED = 2.5;
23:   const ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 2000; // ms
24:   const FUEL_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 8000; // ms
25: 
26:   // --- Game state ---
27:   const ship = {
28:     x: width / 2,
29:     y: height / 2,
30:     vx: 0,
31:     vy: 0,
32:     angle: -Math.PI / 2,
33:     fuel: 100,
34:     thrusting: false,
35:     turningLeft: false,
36:     turningRight: false,
37:   };
38: 
39:   const asteroids = [];
40:   const fuels = [];
41:   let lastAsteroidSpawn = 0;
42:   let lastFuelSpawn = 0;
43:   let gameOver = false;
44: 
45:   // --- Input handling ---
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
47:     switch (e.code) {
48:       case 'ArrowUp':
49:         ship.thrusting = true;
50:         break;
51:       case 'ArrowLeft':
52:         ship.turningLeft = true;
53:         break;
54:       case 'ArrowRight':
55:         ship.turningRight = true;
56:         break;
57:     }
58:   });
59:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
60:     switch (e.code) {
61:       case 'ArrowUp':
62:         ship.thrusting = false;
63:         break;
64:       case 'ArrowLeft':
65:         ship.turningLeft = false;
66:         break;
67:       case 'ArrowRight':
68:         ship.turningRight = false;
69:         break;
70:     }
71:   });
72: 
73:   // --- Helper functions ---
74:   function spawnAsteroid() {
75:     // Spawn at random edge
76:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
77:     let x, y, vx, vy;
78:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
79:     const speed = ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED + Math.random() * (ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED - ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED);
80:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
81:     vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
82:     vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
83:     switch (edge) {
84:       case 0: // top
85:         x = Math.random() * width;
86:         y = -radius;
87:         break;
88:       case 1: // right
89:         x = width + radius;
90:         y = Math.random() * height;
91:         break;
92:       case 2: // bottom
93:         x = Math.random() * width;
94:         y = height + radius;
95:         break;
96:       case 3: // left
97:         x = -radius;
98:         y = Math.random() * height;
99:         break;
100:     }
101:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius });
102:   }
103: 
104:   function spawnFuel() {
105:     const radius = 8;
106:     const x = radius + Math.random() * (width - 2 * radius);
107:     const y = radius + Math.random() * (height - 2 * radius);
108:     fuels.push({ x, y, radius });
109:   }
110: 
111:   function distance(ax, ay, bx, by) {
112:     const dx = ax - bx;
113:     const dy = ay - by;
114:     return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
115:   }
116: 
117:   function drawShip() {
118:     ctx.save();
119:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
120:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
121:     ctx.beginPath();
122:     ctx.moveTo(SHIP_SIZE, 0);
123:     ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 0.6, SHIP_SIZE * 0.8);
124:     ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 0.6, -SHIP_SIZE * 0.8);
125:     ctx.closePath();
126:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
127:     ctx.fill();
128:     ctx.restore();
129:   }
130: 
131:   function drawAsteroid(a) {
132:     ctx.beginPath();
133:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
134:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
135:     ctx.fill();
136:   }
137: 
138:   function drawFuel(f) {
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
141:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
142:     ctx.fill();
143:   }
144: 
145:   function drawFuelBar() {
146:     const barWidth = 100;
147:     const barHeight = 8;
148:     const x = 10;
149:     const y = 10;
150:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
151:     ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, barWidth + 2, barHeight + 2);
152:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
153:     const fuelRatio = Math.max(0, ship.fuel) / 100;
154:     ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth * fuelRatio, barHeight);
155:   }
156: 
157:   function update(dt) {
158:     // Turn ship
159:     if (ship.turningLeft) ship.angle -= SHIP_TURN_SPEED;
160:     if (ship.turningRight) ship.angle += SHIP_TURN_SPEED;
161: 
162:     // Thrust
163:     if (ship.thrusting && ship.fuel > 0) {
164:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * SHIP_THRUST;
165:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * SHIP_THRUST;
166:       ship.fuel -= FUEL_DEPLETION; // fuel used while thrusting
167:     } else {
168:       // passive fuel consumption
169:       ship.fuel -= FUEL_DEPLETION * 0.2;
170:     }
171: 
172:     // Move ship
173:     ship.x += ship.vx;
174:     ship.y += ship.vy;
175: 
176:     // Screen wrap for ship
177:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
178:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
179:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
180:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
181: 
182:     // Update asteroids
183:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
184:       const a = asteroids[i];
185:       a.x += a.vx;
186:       a.y += a.vy;
187:       // wrap
188:       if (a.x < -a.radius) a.x += width + a.radius * 2;
189:       if (a.x > width + a.radius) a.x -= width + a.radius * 2;
190:       if (a.y < -a.radius) a.y += height + a.radius * 2;
191:       if (a.y > height + a.radius) a.y -= height + a.radius * 2;
192:       // collision with ship
193:       if (distance(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < SHIP_SIZE + a.radius) {
194:         gameOver = true;
195:         break;
196:       }
197:     }
198: 
199:     // Check fuel pickups
200:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
201:       const f = fuels[i];
202:       if (distance(ship.x, ship.y, f.x, f.y) < SHIP_SIZE + f.radius) {
203:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + FUEL_PICKUP_AMOUNT);
204:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
205:       }
206:     }
207: 
208:     // Lose if out of fuel
209:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
210: 
211:     // Spawn new asteroids / fuel based on timers
212:     const now = performance.now();
213:     if (now - lastAsteroidSpawn > ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
214:       spawnAsteroid();
215:       lastAsteroidSpawn = now;
216:     }
217:     if (now - lastFuelSpawn > FUEL_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
218:       spawnFuel();
219:       lastFuelSpawn = now;
220:     }
221:   }
222: 
223:   function render() {
224:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
225:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
226:     drawShip();
227:     asteroids.forEach(drawAsteroid);
228:     fuels.forEach(drawFuel);
229:     drawFuelBar();
230:   }
231: 
232:   function loop(timestamp) {
233:     if (gameOver) {
234:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
235:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
236:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
237:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
238:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
239:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
240:       return;
241:     }
242:     update(timestamp);
243:     render();
244:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
245:   }
246: 
247:   // Initialise first spawn timers
248:   lastAsteroidSpawn = performance.now();
249:   lastFuelSpawn = performance.now();
250:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
251: })();

(End of file - total 251 lines)
